texts.facts: The present petition has been filed challenging the impugned recovery certificate, dated 4.6.2025 issued against the petitioner in pursuance of the order of the Additional District Magistrate (City), Ghaziabad/Adjudicating Authority, passed under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Learned Standing Counsel at the outset has stated that against the order of the Adjudicating Authority, dated 19.3.2025, the petitioner has already filed an appeal before the Food Safety and Standards Tribunal, Meerut, under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. In the said appeal an application for grant of interim order has also been filed.
